from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

input_path = Path("results/pressure_probes.csv")
output_dir = Path("postprocessed/pressure")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

pressure = pd.read_csv(input_path)
required = {"time_s", "probe_id", "pressure_pa"}
if not required.issubset(pressure.columns):
    raise ValueError(f"Input must contain {sorted(required)}")

reference_density_kg_m3 = 998.0
reference_velocity_m_s = 2.4
dynamic_pressure_pa = 0.5 * reference_density_kg_m3 * reference_velocity_m_s**2
pressure["cp"] = pressure["pressure_pa"].astype(float) / dynamic_pressure_pa
pressure = pressure.dropna(subset=["time_s", "cp"]).sort_values(["probe_id", "time_s"])
if pressure.empty:
    raise ValueError("No valid pressure probe records are available.")

pressure.to_csv(output_dir / "pressure_coefficient_history.csv", index=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
for probe_id, group in pressure.groupby("probe_id", sort=True):
    ax.plot(group["time_s"], group["cp"], label=str(probe_id), linewidth=1.4)
ax.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
ax.set_ylabel("Pressure coefficient")
ax.set_title("Pressure coefficient at monitoring probes")
ax.legend(title="Probe", ncol=2)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(output_dir / "pressure_coefficient_history.png", dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
